title: Keep writing paqad stage agents to the home folder when the plugin is not installed?
context: This change stops writing paqad-* agents into each project's .claude/agents folder; the plugin becomes the one source on Claude Code. Today paqad also writes them to the Developer's home ~/.claude/agents. If that stops too, a Developer who installed paqad from npm without the plugin has no stage agents and stages cannot dispatch.
